name: Karumi
description:
Karumi is an AI-powered product demo platform for SaaS companies. This connector lets you run your Karumi workspace directly from Claude using natural language.

Explore demos and sessions: browse and filter prospect demo sessions, deep-dive any session with its full transcript, and run keyword or semantic search across all conversations to see what prospects are asking about.

Manage your demo experiences: create and update audiences (shareable, campaign-specific entry points), edit reusable demo journeys and start pages, update an agent's system prompt, and add knowledge files — all without leaving Claude.

Surface leads and insights: pull lead records and engagement analytics, review Q&A content, and generate summaries from real demo activity to feed your sales and marketing workflows.

Built-in safety: every tool is annotated as read-only or destructive, so Claude asks before any action that creates, updates, or deletes. Access is scoped to the organizations your account belongs to and authorized via OAuth 2.0.

Ideal for sales, marketing, and product teams who want to monitor demo performance, qualify leads, and iterate on their AI demos conversationally.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Karumi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Karumi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.karumi.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Karumi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Karumi lists 38 MCP tools, including add_knowledge_file, answer_question, create_api_key, create_audience, delete_audience, delete_qa_answer, duplicate_start_page, get_agent, get_agent_analytics, get_audience, get_journey, and get_recording_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Karumi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Karumi in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Karumi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Karumi is developed by Karumi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
